The '''Xuanfang Wardens''' are the primary military force of the frontier region of Xuanfang within the province of [[Mengzhou]]. They stand as the final bulwark protecting the Hold, alongside the Autopuppets. Legally, their power is derived from the Ministry of War established by Mengzhou City Hall. Among their ranks serve the Xuan Watchers, an elite formation forged to confront only the most formidable Tacet Discords. The Wardens and the Xuan Triad are led by Warden Commander [[Qiuhong]].

The Xuan Paragon [[Qingxiao]] is seldom seen within the Hold, yet whenever calamity looms, she always appears to stand as Xuanfang's protector. In response to the disappearances occurring throughout the Hold, Yangyang, an Outrider from Jinzhou, has been temporarily transferred to the Wardens. Serving as one of the Xuan Watchers, she lends her expertise in support of the Land of Xuanfang.
